with.description: The other workspaces, by policy key, comma-separated.

from.description: Historical: the groups whose holders belong, comma-separated, carried by records written before the groups became the record's targets and no longer written; the groups are the targets and `sources` counts them. Declared so those records still read.

sources.description: How many directory groups feed it; the groups are the record's targets.

members.description: How many individual addresses are listed beside the groups; the addresses are the record's targets.

privacy.description: The visibility: public, private, or one workspace=public|private pair per side.

changes.description: For an edit, what changed, as 'field: before -> after' parts; empty otherwise.
